title: What a disappointment!
text: What a disappointment!. There are 2 settings. High and Low, but neither setting puts out much air.  Total waste of money. I have a small fan of the same brand that puts out much more air than this one. Save your money.

product_metadata.title: Vornado HELIX2 Personal Tower Fan with 2 Speed Settings, Illuminated Touch Controls, 70-Degrees of Oscillation, Small Footprint, Black
features: SUPERIOR SUPPORT — When you choose a Vornado Tower Fan, you’re investing in superior performance and design that will deliver total satisfaction. If not, we’ll replace it, for 5 years..Number of speeds:2
COMPACT DESIGN — At just 11. 7" tall and 4" wide, HELIX2 is perfect for a breeze in tight quarters such as a desk, nightstand, or tabletop.
LED ILLUMINATED TOUCH CONTROLS — 2 speed settings can easily be adjusted through the intuitive one touch button with separate back-lit button for oscillation on demand.
SUPERIOR OSCILLATION — Unique, twisted design provides 70 degrees of gentle, yet steady oscillating airflow.
PERSONAL COMFORT — Personal air comfort without disrupting your surroundings. HELIX2 will keep the cool moving while keeping your stationery stationary.
Built to meet U. S. voltage requirements. Certified, safety-tested, and warrantied for use only in the U. S.
description: Welcome to the future with the all new HELIX2, the personal tower circulator with a twist. The intriguing design will pull you in for a closer look and the gentle but steady air flow will keep you in cool comfort. The HELIX2 features 2 speeds and illuminated touch controls. With 70 degrees of oscillating air flow, the HELIX2 will keep the cool moving – with a promise to keep your stationery stationary.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
